description: Compiled/minified JavaScript code for an HTTP proxy module, including event emitter implementation and redirect handling.

classes.name: Events
classes.description: Event handling base class with event registration and emission capabilities.

classes.name: EE
classes.description: Event listener wrapper with callback, context, and 'once' flag.

classes.name: EventEmitter
classes.description: Implements event-driven architecture with methods for adding, removing, and emitting events.

classes.name: RedirectableRequest
classes.description: Handles HTTP requests with support for redirects, request body buffering, and timeout management.

classes.name: ProxyServer
classes.description: Creates and manages an HTTP/HTTPS proxy server with WebSocket support, error handling, and request modification.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds an event listener to an EventEmitter instance.

methods.name: clearEvent
methods.description: Removes all listeners for a specific event.

methods.name: eventNames
methods.description: Returns an array of event names registered on the EventEmitter.

methods.name: listeners
methods.description: Returns an array of listeners for a specific event.

methods.name: listenerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of listeners for a specific event.

methods.name: emit
methods.description: Emits an event, invoking all registered listeners with provided arguments.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a specific listener for an event.

methods.name: removeAllListeners
methods.description: Removes all listeners for a specific event or all events.

methods.name: setHeader
methods.description: Sets a header on the outgoing request.

methods.name: removeHeader
methods.description: Removes a header from the outgoing request.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets a timeout for the request.

methods.name: _sanitizeOptions
methods.description: Sanitizes and normalizes request options before making a request.

methods.name: _performRequest
methods.description: Executes the HTTP request, handling redirects and response processing.

methods.name: _processResponse
methods.description: Processes the HTTP response, handling redirects if necessary.
